hints: graphInit must clear deg[] for indices 0..n inclusive, because vertices are numbered from 1 and index n is a real vertex.
addEdge is one line: g->adj[u][g->deg[u]++] = v; The post-increment stores at the current end and then grows the list.
Write the comparator as (x > y) - (x < y) rather than x - y. The subtraction overflows for large values; the comparison form never does.
